name: @activepieces/piece-exa
description: AI-powered search and content extraction from the web.

get_contents.name: get_contents
get_contents.description: Retrieve clean HTML content from specified URLs.

text.description: If true, returns full page text. If false, disables text return.

aiMetadata.description: Crawls and extracts clean page content (and optionally full text) from a given list of URLs via Exa. Use when an agent already has specific URLs and needs their on-page content rather than running a web search; optionally fetch matching subpages by keyword. Requires an array of URLs as input. Read-only and idempotent.

generate_answer.name: generate_answer
generate_answer.description: Provides direct answers to queries by summarizing results.

query.description: Ask a question to get summarized answers from the web.

text.description: If true, includes full text content from the search results

model.description: Choose the Exa model to use for the answer.

aiMetadata.description: Asks Exa a natural-language question and returns a synthesized answer grounded in live web search results. Use when an agent wants a direct factual answer rather than a list of links to triage itself; choose the exa or exa-pro model. Requires a query string. Read-only lookup; repeating the same query is safe though phrasing and live web data may vary the wording.

perform_search.name: perform_search
perform_search.description: Search the web using semantic or keyword-based search.

query.description: Search query to find related articles and data.

category.description: Category of data to focus the search on.

includeDomains.description: Limit results to only these domains.

startCrawlDate.description: Only include results crawled after this ISO date.

endCrawlDate.description: Only include results crawled before this ISO date.

startPublishedDate.description: Only include results published after this ISO date.

endPublishedDate.description: Only include results published before this ISO date.

includeText.description: Strings that must be present in the text of results.

excludeText.description: Strings that must not be present in the text of results.

aiMetadata.description: Runs a web search through Exa and returns matching results with page text. Use when an agent needs to discover relevant URLs/content for a query; the search type can be auto, neural (semantic), or keyword, and results can be narrowed by category, domain include/exclude lists, crawl/publish date ranges, and required/forbidden text. Requires a query string. Read-only and idempotent.

find_similar_links.name: find_similar_links
find_similar_links.description: Find pages similar to a given URL.

url.description: Reference URL to find semantically similar links.

includeDomains.description: List of domains to include in results.

excludeDomains.description: List of domains to exclude from results.

startCrawlDate.description: Include links crawled after this date (ISO format).

endCrawlDate.description: Include links crawled before this date (ISO format).

startPublishedDate.description: Only include links published after this date (ISO format).

endPublishedDate.description: Only include links published before this date (ISO format).

includeText.description: Strings that must be present in the webpage text (max 1 string of up to 5 words).

excludeText.description: Strings that must not be present in the webpage text (max 1 string of up to 5 words).

aiMetadata.description: Finds web pages semantically similar to a single reference URL via Exa. Use when an agent has one example page and wants more of the same kind rather than searching by a text query; results can be narrowed by domain include/exclude lists, crawl/publish date ranges, and required/forbidden text. Requires a reference URL. Read-only and idempotent.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

headers.description: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.

response_is_binary.description: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
